name: claudeconnect
notes: Fable 5.1 is always in the model picker, marked as using usage credits. If your Claude account has none, the picker says so, and a message to Fable 5.1 tells you you have no usage credits instead of being sent.

The edit command in the terminal now has every setting the site's Settings has: the theme, which Claude Code chats the site lists, the working folder, using usage credits from the site, a new address, and deleting the site.
The theme is kept on the site, so it's the same on every device.
Bringing chats over from claude.ai's data export is gone, and chats brought over that way are removed from the site. They're still on claude.ai.
